wish: someone should make a puzzle web game where you book a flight on a badly designed website
spec:
Four-level puzzle: book Lisbon to Oslo on a deliberately hostile booking site.
Tap the broken widgets (backward month, +3 letter dials, inverted checkboxes, shuffled seat map) and the dishonestly labelled buttons to reach the confirmation.
It books nothing real and has no network; it keeps only your best tap count on this device.
